_comment: Two-tier v2 follow-up L2d (2026-09-17 late, user decision: 'longer lookback'): the passing L2 axis (B, segments attention; gate L2 PASS on both seeds at seq_len 61 = 4 segments / 122 s) re-trained with seq_len 121 = 8 coarse 30 s segments / 242 s of history. The E2E misses with the best tracker are both on the vectored stratum and inherited from L2's long-lead vectored error (B's fixed-anchor vectored p50 1396 m at 180 s, 3449 m at 300 s). Its own fixed anchor is 120; the readout pairs it with the seq_len-61 B arms and the references at that common anchor. Cohort 8741 train / 2052 val (1117 train flights dropped by the 30 s future contract, 308 tracks shorter than the window): a 13 % smaller, longer-flight training set — a probe beside L2c, not a like-for-like arm.
